trigger: new command-delivery task, unknown repository state, or fresh-agent pickup

steps.action: Read AGENTS.md, focused codebase map, manifest, registries, and operator guide before mutation.
Inspect Git state, active PR, recent history, and collision boundaries; preserve unrelated work with an isolated branch or worktree.
Route exactly one primary skill and required composed skills from the registry and trigger fixtures.
Run the status reporter and record missing components before implementation.

failurePolicy: Stop before mutation when repository identity, ownership, authority, or collision state is unresolved.
proofCeiling: Read-only intake, deterministic route selection, and observed repository state only.
